params.markdown:
#### Trellix ePO On-Prem

**DLP Incident Events**

This dashboard gives visibility into Trellix ePO Data Loss Prevention incidents, highlighting total incident volume, trends over time, reviewer activity, triggered DLP rules, severity levels, and affected data classifications. Use the reviewer control to focus the dashboard on a specific analyst account and support security oversight, incident review, and data protection analysis.

**[Integration Page](/app/integrations/detail/trellix_epo_on_prem/overview)**
